statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116330 (PostgreSQL pg_dump tar restore.sql fails to block psql command injection) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16 for major version 16. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116330/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/40a81579e13f8351dec8370d64e61d39f27d0688, which carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116330", is contained in the REL_16_16 tag and not in REL_16_15, and changes main() in src/bin/pg_dump/pg_dump.c so that tar format, like plain format, gets a generated restrict key, which the undocumented restore.sql archive member then uses instead of the literal "(null)" key, and widens the --restrict-key error message to name both formats; its other changes are the pg_dump reference page, the pg_dump test build files and a new test. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116330 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the C source files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql16 16.16-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 16.16 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql16 at 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0. The vulnerable code is pg_dump, usr/libexec/postgresql16/pg_dump, which the postgresql16-client subpackage ships in every published build on both architectures. In the 16.16-r0 build the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 16.16 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) it reports that older 16.x release on both architectures. The error message the fix adds, "option %s can only be used with %s or %s", is present in pg_dump in the 16.16-r0 build and absent from it in every earlier build, on both architectures, and pg_dump reports "(PostgreSQL) 16.16" in 16.16-r0 and the older 16.x release in each earlier build. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 16.16, so they are affected; 16.16-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116330 (pg_dump's tar-format restore.sql uses a predictable restriction key, so a compromised origin server can inject psql commands; a gap in the fix for CVE-2025-8714) in 17.12 on the 17 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116330/. Checked every published build of this owner on amd64 and arm64: the server binary in 17.12-0 and in the build of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12, which contains the fix; the earlier builds, 17.11-1 and the build of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1, report PostgreSQL 17.11 and are affected. pg_dump is shipped in the postgresql-client-17 package of the builds of Debian's versions and in the 17.11-1 and 17.12-0 packages, and its version string matches the server's in every build.
